prose: OpenAI announced a partnership with Cathedral to test its security defenses and a revamped Security Bug Bounty program that quadruples rewards for critical findings, alongside a planned internal security sprint bringing outside researchers together with its own teams. In the same week that WorkOS attributed a breach to an autonomous AI pentest framework, the frontier labs are paying up to be attacked on friendly terms.
highlights: OpenAI partners with Cathedral on security testing; bug bounty rewards for critical findings quadrupled
Timing: defensive security spending rises as autonomous AI attack tooling shows up in real breach reports
